basic_info.description: Discover this Edwardian gem at 20 Wright Street, a 4-bed, 2-bath residence with breathtaking city views nestled on a quiet street in Bernal Heights. The charming facade and welcoming front porch invite you into an open sunlit living space, featuring a built-in bench and bookshelves. The kitchen dazzles with stainless steel appliances, a gas range, a bold blue tile backsplash, and freshly painted cabinets. The nook, bathed in light from a skylight and surrounding windows, is the perfect place to gather for morning coffee or a digestif. Sliding doors open to a deck and lush backyard oasis complete with rustic pergola and landscaping. Main-level bedroom with bay window seat offers flexibility for home office. The upper level hosts two bedrooms with vaulted ceilings, walk-in hallway closet, and full bathroom with shower. The lower level offers a private bedroom, en-suite bath with shower over tub, and backyard access. 1-car garage, laundry, and separate storage room (or home gym!) round out this home. Play with the flexibility to customize three levels of living space to suit your needs. This move-in ready home is a serene retreat from the city's bustle, yet close enough to Cortland Avenue's vibrant scene with easy access to 101/280 and major commute routes.
